subtitle: Your personal AI, with context
slogan: A little more room for life.
promotionalText: Talk things through, hand off a task, and keep the thoughts you want to remember. Impo brings your conversations, Echo recordings, and daily Brief together.
description:
A little more room for life.

Impo is your personal AI assistant for the thoughts, tasks, and everyday details you choose to share. Talk things through, capture a thought with Echo, or hand off a task and come back when it is ready.

TALK IT THROUGH
Keep an ongoing conversation with your assistant. Type a message or hold the input to speak. Read clear answers with lists, tables, code, and formulas, then select and copy the parts you need.

GIVE A TASK ITS OWN SPACE
Start an independent task for research, planning, or a first draft. Each task has its own conversation, so you can ask follow-up questions and find the result later. Open, share, and save files delivered with a reply. Server-side work continues when you leave the app.

KEEP THE THOUGHT WITH ECHO
Start Echo when you want to capture spoken thoughts. It turns recorded speech into a transcript timeline you can revisit and delete. Recording starts only when you choose, with optional place context.

A BRIEF THAT STARTS WITH YOU
Get personal Brief cards based on your recent conversations, completed tasks, and Echo transcripts. Choose your briefing times and look back through earlier editions.

LESS REPEATING, MORE REMEMBERING
Impo saves useful context from your conversations and Echo, then brings relevant memories into Chat. Browse those memories and forget the ones you no longer want kept.

CONNECT ON YOUR TERMS
Choose whether to connect supported services or grant access to Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and Health. Connections are optional. Control Chat, Task, and Brief notifications separately in Settings.

Impo is open source: https://github.com/impoai/impo

An Apple or Google account and an internet connection are required. AI features process information through Impo and its service providers; review the in-app notices and Privacy Policy before sharing. AI answers can be inaccurate. Health features are informational, not medical advice.

Privacy: https://impo.ai/privacy/
Support: https://impo.ai/support/
reviewNotes:
REVIEW ACCESS
Impo requires an account because conversations, tasks, recordings, memories, and preferences are private and synchronized with its backend. The welcome screen offers Continue with Apple and Continue with Google. Continue with Apple supports creating a new account; an invitation or paid plan is not required. Complete the AI processing notice, skip optional data connections, then name your assistant and choose its appearance.

This preparation record does not yet contain a dedicated reviewer account. Reviewer access will be finalized and tested with the selected submission build. The current binary does not offer password entry or a fully featured reviewer demo mode.

FEATURE WALKTHROUGH
1. Chat: type "Help me plan a quiet weekend" and send. Hold the empty input field to record a voice message; release to transcribe and send, or slide up to cancel. Microphone access is optional.
2. Tasks: open Tasks, tap +, then Add a Task. Enter a research or planning request. Work can continue on the server after leaving the screen. Reopen the task to see its result and ask a follow-up question. Request a short PDF and tap its file card to preview, share, or save it.
3. Echo: tap the Echo control, read the recording disclosure, and start recording. Stop explicitly when finished. Completed transcripts appear in Echo. Open a recording to view or delete it. Please use your own speech or obtain permission before recording another person.
4. Brief: editions are produced in scheduled background runs from saved account context. A new account may initially have no editions. Choose briefing times in Brief settings; content is not generated instantly on every refresh.
5. Memories: open About you in the Echo/Memory area to browse memories created from account context. Individual memories can be forgotten.
6. Connections: Chat > Settings > Connections. Native data and external accounts are optional and can be disconnected. Calendar and Health are read-only. Reminders can be created only on request; Contacts are read-only.
7. Notifications: Chat > Settings > Notifications. Chat, Task, and Brief have separate switches. Foreground banners are suppressed.

BACKGROUND AUDIO / LOCATION
Echo records only after the user starts it and grants microphone access. It can continue while the screen is locked; a Live Activity exposes recording status and Stop. Optional recording-time location accompanies Echo only while recording. Normal Brief city refresh occurs in the foreground. No background microphone session is started by a push notification.

DATA PROCESSING
The app uses Clerk for authentication, Rebyte for AI agent execution, Google Gemini for speech transcription and memory embeddings, and Composio for optional external connections. Data and optional permission disclosures are described at https://impo.ai/privacy/.

PREPARATION STATUS
No build has been selected for App Store review. Before submission, replace these preparation notes with verified reviewer access and instructions matching the final build. The 1.0 (48) TestFlight candidate includes in-app account deletion: Settings > Delete account, review the warning, tap Continue, type DELETE, then confirm. Older TestFlight builds before 48 open a support email instead. Confirm its operation and Apple reauthorization with a disposable account in the final build before submission. Scheduled Tasks are not implemented and are not advertised in the product description.
